web.sentenceEn: Internet access will continue to grow in importance as we edge further towards web 3.0, and greater resources and initiatives are needed to provide the underprivileged with the connectivity they desperately need to learn, work and live.

warming.sentenceEn: Although there are huge uncertainties as to the precise impacts of climate change, enough is known to say that global warming represents one of the main threats to Africa's prosperity.

warming.sentenceEn: In reality, carbon taxes alone won't be enough to halt global warming , but they would be a useful part of any climate plan.

welfare.sentenceEn: No sense of the dependence of our own material welfare on their work ever strikes our national consciousness.

welfare.sentenceEn: Every single measure of material and environmental welfare in America, Europe, Asia, Africa and the world as a whole has improved rather than deteriorated.
welfare.translationZh: 无论是美洲、欧洲、亚洲、非洲，还是全球整体，其物质与环境福祉的各项指标均呈现改善而非恶化的趋势。
welfare.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第4句

welfare.sentenceEn: It found animal welfare came top of a list of issues that people considered before buying clothes, with 42% saying it was important to them.
welfare.translationZh: 研究发现，动物福利问题在人们购买服装前考虑的诸多因素中位居榜首，42%的受访者表示这一点对他们很重要。
welfare.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第2句

welfare.sentenceEn: Hunting "designed to secure the aggregate welfare of the target species, the integrity of its ecosystem, or both"—what Varner terms "therapeutic hunting"—is defensible, while subsistence and sport hunting—both of which only benefit human beings—are not.
welfare.translationZh: 那些"旨在保障目标物种的整体福祉、其生态系统的完整性，或两者兼具"的狩猎——瓦纳称之为"治疗性狩猎"——是具有正当性的，而仅为人类利益服务的生存狩猎和运动狩猎则不然。
welfare.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第2句

welfare.sentenceEn: The environmental welfare has worsened in the world.
welfare.translationZh: 全球环境福祉已经恶化。

widespread.sentenceEn: In 2006 the United Nations Food and Agriculture Organization (FAO) published a study titled "Livestock's Long Shadow," which received widespread international attention.
widespread.translationZh: 2006年，联合国粮食及农业组织（FAO）发布了一项题为《畜牧业的长影》的研究报告，引起了国际社会的广泛关注。

widespread.sentenceEn: To create this kind of widespread passion, learning leaders must expose the workforce to what could be, which will enable them to rethink their mental models, enable them to break free from their deep-rooted paradigms and embrace the opportunity to learn.
widespread.translationZh: 为了培养这种广泛的热情，学习型领导者必须让员工接触未来的可能性，这将使他们能够重新思考自己的思维模式，摆脱根深蒂固的固有观念，并拥抱学习的机会。
widespread.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第3句

widespread.sentenceEn: The study published in Current Anthropology is the largest and most comprehensive and widespread survey of morals ever conducted and aimed to find out whether different societies had different versions of morality.
widespread.translationZh: 发表在《当代人类学》上的这项研究是迄今为止规模最大、最全面且最广泛的道德观念调查，旨在探究不同社会是否存在不同版本的道德体系。
widespread.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第1句

widespread.sentenceEn: In developing countries there is a low life expectancy, a high infant mortality rate, high levels of unemployment and illiteracy, nutritional levels below acceptable standards and widespread disease with very little or poor quality medical assistance.
widespread.translationZh: 发展中国家的预期寿命较低，婴儿死亡率较高，失业率和文盲率居高不下，营养水平低于可接受标准，疾病普遍存在，医疗援助极少或质量低劣。
widespread.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第2句

widespread.sentenceEn: A clinical psychologist finds perfectionism is widespread among his clients.
widespread.translationZh: 一位临床心理学家发现完美主义在他的客户中十分普遍。

widespread.sentenceEn: It refers to opinions that are radical and widespread .
widespread.translationZh: 它指的是极端且广泛存在的观点。

wildlife.sentenceEn: But these conventionally managed campuses can come at a cost: increased cancer risk, contaminated waterways, poisoned wildlife and lifeless soil.
wildlife.translationZh: 但这些传统管理的校园可能会付出代价：癌症风险增加、水道污染、野生动物中毒以及土壤失去生机。
wildlife.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第4句

wildlife.sentenceEn: We are in the midst of the sixth great extinction event of life on our planet, which not only threatens wildlife species, but also imperils the global food supply.
wildlife.translationZh: 我们正处于地球生命的第六次大灭绝事件之中，这不仅威胁着野生物种，也危及全球粮食供应。
wildlife.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第5段，第4句

wildlife.sentenceEn: It used to refer to people trying to protect wildlife and natural ecosystems.
wildlife.translationZh: 它过去指的是那些致力于保护野生动物和自然生态系统的人。
wildlife.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第2句

wildlife.sentenceEn: With rewilding now firmly on the environmental policy agenda, the hope is that in future, spiders will be enabled to migrate by themselves, adapting to climate change by moving along wildlife corridors.
wildlife.translationZh: 随着生态恢复现已被正式提上环境政策议程，人们希望未来蜘蛛将能够自行迁徙，通过野生动物走廊移动来适应气候变化。
wildlife.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第5段，第3句

wildlife.sentenceEn: Elizabeth Lev believes increased contact with more wildlife helps conserve biodiversity.
wildlife.translationZh: 伊丽莎白·莱夫认为，增加与更多野生动物的接触有助于保护生物多样性。

wildlife.sentenceEn: It posed an unprecedented threat to the wildlife around Antarctica.
wildlife.translationZh: 这对南极周围的野生动物构成了前所未有的威胁。

worried.sentenceEn: Why are we so worried about our careers?
worried.translationZh: 我们为什么这么担心自己的职业生涯？
worried.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第1句

worried.sentenceEn: Public health experts are worried because loneliness seems to be on the rise, and studies have long found correlations between loneliness and an assortment of medical conditions that threaten health and longevity.
worried.translationZh: 公共卫生专家对此感到担忧，因为孤独感似乎在不断加剧，并且长期以来的研究发现，孤独感与多种威胁健康和寿命的疾病之间存在关联。
worried.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第3句

worried.sentenceEn: I was worried that the menu might not be accommodating.
worried.translationZh: 我之前还担心菜单可能不够多样化呢。
worried.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第2句

worried.sentenceEn: Once upon a time, it was of great survival value to be worried about everything that could go wrong.
worried.translationZh: 从前，对一切可能出错的事情保持警惕具有重要的生存价值。
worried.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第4句

worried.sentenceEn: While rich parents are more concerned with their children's psychological well-being, poor parents are more worried about their children's safety.
worried.translationZh: 富裕父母更关注孩子的心理健康，而贫困父母则更担心孩子的安全。

worried.sentenceEn: They are worried about being alienated from the outside world.

wisdom.sentenceEn: They further hypothesize that older adults may be well served by their prior knowledge when it comes to decision-making, where they can pull on their accumulated wisdom .
wisdom.translationZh: 他们进一步假设，在决策方面，老年人可能会从自己的先验知识中受益匪浅，因为他们可以运用自己积累的智慧。
wisdom.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第3句

wisdom.sentenceEn: Where changing a strongly deep-rooted habit requires changing our belief about that habit that penetrates deeply into our lives, continually manifesting that wisdom requires that we maintain a positive outlook.
wisdom.translationZh: 改变根深蒂固的习惯需要改变我们对这种深入生活的习惯的认知，而持续展现这种智慧则需要我们保持积极的心态。

wisdom.sentenceEn: If our mood is low, the wisdom to behave differently seems to disappear and we go back to eating more and exercising less.
wisdom.translationZh: 当我们情绪低落时，改变行为的智慧似乎消失了，我们会回到多吃少动的状态。

wisdom.sentenceEn: Yet he was also reflecting the wisdom of religious and philosophical traditions that extend back thousands of years.
wisdom.translationZh: 然而，他同时也在反映那些可追溯至数千年前的宗教与哲学传统中的智慧。

wisdom.sentenceEn: Without a happy mood, it seems that our wisdom to adopt a different behavior vanishes.
wisdom.translationZh: 如果没有愉悦的心情，我们采取不同行为的智慧似乎就会消失。

wisdom.sentenceEn: They can rely on their accumulated wisdom in an emergency.
wisdom.translationZh: 在紧急情况下，他们可以依靠自己积累的智慧。

witness.sentenceEn: Beyond competent workers and supervisors, it's important to educate everyone within the organization that they are obliged to intervene if they witness a possible unsafe act, whether you're a designated competent person, a supervisor or a frontline worker.
witness.translationZh: 除了合格的员工和主管外，重要的是要让组织内的每个人都明白：无论你是指定的合格人员、主管还是一线员工，只要目睹可能不安全的行为，都有义务进行干预。
witness.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第9段，第1句

witness.sentenceEn: Every day people witness things on the street and choose to stand idly by.
witness.translationZh: 每天，人们在街上目睹各种事情，却选择袖手旁观。
witness.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第2句

witness.sentenceEn: This is known as the bystander effect—the more people who witness an event, the less likely anyone in that group is to help the victim.
witness.translationZh: 这被称为旁观者效应——目击事件的人越多，群体中任何人帮助受害者的可能性就越小。
witness.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第3句

witness.sentenceEn: Due to its material nature, architecture is one field where you will be able to clearly witness the contribution you make to a city.
witness.translationZh: 由于其物质属性，建筑学是一个能让你清晰见证自己对城市贡献的领域。
witness.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第7段，第2句

witness.sentenceEn: What would we witness in the setting of communitarianism?
witness.translationZh: 在社群主义的背景下，我们会看到什么样的景象？

witness.sentenceEn: People have witnessed a tug of war between Republicans and Democrats over tax cuts.
witness.translationZh: 人们目睹了共和党与民主党之间围绕减税问题的激烈较量。

wooden.sentenceEn: Reflecting on generosity and gratitude, the great basketball coach John Wooden once offered two counsels to his players and students.
wooden.translationZh: 在思考慷慨与感恩的意义时，伟大的篮球教练约翰·伍登曾给他的球员和学生们提出过两条忠告。

wooden.sentenceEn: In saying this, Wooden sought to promote purely generous acts, as opposed to those performed with an expectation of reward.
wooden.translationZh: 通过这句话，伍登旨在倡导纯粹的慷慨行为，而非那些期望获得回报的行为。

wooden.sentenceEn: If the wooden frame of the towers had caught fire, it could have sent the bells—the largest of which, the Emmanuel Bell, weighs 13 tons—crashing down, potentially causing the collapse of both towers.
wooden.translationZh: 如果塔楼的木质框架起火，就可能导致这些钟——其中最大的“ Emmanuel 钟”重达13吨——轰然坠落，进而可能造成两座塔楼坍塌。

wooden.sentenceEn: Most of the wooden roof beams have been burned, and parts of the concrete holding up the roof have collapsed.
wooden.translationZh: 大部分木质屋顶横梁已被烧毁，支撑屋顶的部分混凝土结构也已坍塌。

wooden.sentenceEn: Had the bell towers' wooden frames burned down, the heavy bells would have crashed down.
wooden.translationZh: 如果钟楼的木质框架被烧毁，沉重的钟就会坠落。

workforce.sentenceEn: To create this kind of widespread passion, learning leaders must expose the workforce to what could be, which will enable them to rethink their mental models, enable them to break free from their deep-rooted paradigms and embrace the opportunity to learn.
workforce.translationZh: 为了培养这种广泛的热情，学习型领导者必须让员工接触未来的可能性，这将使他们能够重新思考自己的思维模式，摆脱根深蒂固的固有观念，并拥抱学习的机会。
workforce.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第3句

workforce.sentenceEn: Managers like her, who seek input even from non-experts to shape their decisions, can find greater support and cooperation from their workforce , she says.
workforce.translationZh: 她说，像她这样的管理者，即使是向非专家征求意见以制定决策，也能从员工那里获得更多支持与合作。

workforce.sentenceEn: By doing so, we will be able to build affordable housing within acceptable commuting distances for a significant bulk of the workforce .
workforce.translationZh: 通过这样做，我们将能够为大部分劳动力在可接受的通勤距离内建造经济适用房。

workforce.sentenceEn: M: Yes, I believe that the purpose of higher education is to prepare young people to enter the workforce , and that our current system fails to do this.
workforce.translationZh: 是的，我认为高等教育的目的是培养年轻人进入职场，而我们目前的教育体系未能做到这一点。
workforce.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第1句

workforce.sentenceEn: Yet over the past two decades or so governments and donors have begun to look again at farming as a way of providing jobs for the 13 million young people entering the workforce each year.
workforce.translationZh: 然而，在过去二十年左右的时间里，各国政府和捐赠机构已开始重新将农业视为一种就业途径，以满足每年进入劳动力市场的1300万年轻人的就业需求。

workforce.sentenceEn: They call for enthusiastic support from the workforce .
workforce.translationZh: 他们呼吁全体员工给予热情支持。

wedding.sentenceEn: Not surprisingly, only eight people responded positively to the wedding invitations and money requests.
wedding.translationZh: 不出所料，只有八个人对婚礼邀请和费用要求给予了积极回应。
wedding.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第7句

wedding.sentenceEn: It seems her dream wedding has now become a nightmare.
wedding.translationZh: 看来她的梦幻婚礼如今已变成了一场噩梦。
wedding.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第3句

wedding.sentenceEn: Susan is causing quite the debate online after posting a bizarre Facebook complaint about her now-cancelled wedding .
wedding.translationZh: 苏珊在脸书上发布了一篇关于她现已取消的婚礼的离奇抱怨，在网上引发了不小的争议。
wedding.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第6句

wedding.sentenceEn: We don't need to tell you that weddings can get expensive.
wedding.translationZh: 婚礼开销高昂，这已是众所周知的事实。
wedding.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第1句

wedding.sentenceEn: What do we learn about the wedding of the Canadian woman Susan?
wedding.translationZh: 关于加拿大女子苏珊的婚礼，我们了解到什么？

writing.sentenceEn: Archives preserve historic artifacts, oral histories, digital history projects, and scholarly writings relevant to the community, including minority groups.
writing.translationZh: 档案馆保存与社区相关的历史文物、口述历史、数字历史项目和学术著作，包括少数群体的相关资料。

writing.sentenceEn: Many libraries offer art or writing workshops and groups, and some provide music practice rooms for patrons.
writing.translationZh: 许多图书馆提供艺术或写作工作坊及小组活动，部分图书馆还为读者提供音乐练习室。

writing.sentenceEn: Before blogs existed and everything we read was online, I would go to travel writing seminars by writers who were published in travel magazines.
writing.translationZh: 在博客尚未出现、我们阅读的所有内容还未转移到线上的年代，我常常去参加旅行写作研讨会，主讲的都是那些在旅行杂志上发表过作品的作家。
writing.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第2句

writing.sentenceEn: Many researchers lack the writing skills to describe their results to a general audience.
writing.translationZh: 许多研究人员缺乏向普通大众描述其研究结果的写作能力。
writing.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第5段，第1句

writing.sentenceEn: What does the man do when he engages in writing ?
writing.translationZh: 这位男士在写作时会做什么？

writing.sentenceEn: It fosters correct interpretation of professional writing .
writing.translationZh: 它有助于正确理解专业写作。

whereas.sentenceEn: Some people can drink it at midnight and go straight to sleep, whereas others get feelings of anxiety after a small amount.
whereas.translationZh: 有些人可以在午夜喝了它后直接入睡，而另一些人即使只喝一点点也会感到焦虑。
whereas.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第5句

whereas.sentenceEn: For Africans its consequences will be particularly bitter: whereas other regions were able to grow rich by burning coal and oil, Africa will pay much of the human price without having enjoyed the benefits.
whereas.translationZh: 对非洲人而言，其后果将尤为苦涩：其他地区通过燃烧煤炭和石油实现了富裕，而非洲却要在未曾享受这些益处的情况下，付出巨大的人力代价。

whereas.sentenceEn: "If they're alive today, you can put them in scanning rigs, you can get every detail of their body analysed very carefully and that makes it much easier, whereas working from available photographs is tricky," says Webber, who won an Academy Award for his visual effects work on the 2013 film Gravity.
whereas.translationZh: 韦伯表示：“如果当事人尚在世，你可以让他们进入扫描设备，极其细致地分析他们身体的每一个细节，这会使整个过程容易得多，而仅依据现有照片进行创作则非常棘手。”他曾因2013年电影《地心引力》的视觉特效工作获得奥斯卡奖。

whereas.sentenceEn: Which illustrates the irony of the responsibility/fault fallacy: evading responsibility feels comfortable, but turns out to be a prison; whereas assuming responsibility feels unpleasant, but ends up being freeing.
whereas.translationZh: 这揭示了责任/过错谬误的讽刺之处：逃避责任感觉舒适，结果却成了一座监狱；而承担责任虽然令人不快，最终却带来自由。
whereas.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第3句

whereas.sentenceEn: Asian women prefer to avoid the sun, because being pale or white is considered beautiful whereas a tanned complexion is considered much more beautiful and sexy in the West.
whereas.translationZh: 亚洲女性偏爱防晒，因为白皙的肤色被认为是美丽的，而在西方，古铜色皮肤则被视为更加美丽和性感。
whereas.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第2句

whereas.sentenceEn: Whereas local collaborations sometimes persist past the point of usefulness because of social or academic obligations, international ones can be cultivated and dropped more freely.
whereas.translationZh: 地方合作有时会因社会或学术义务而在失去实用价值后仍继续存在，而国际合作则可以更灵活地建立和终止。
whereas.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第9段，第2句

wireless.sentenceEn: Initially, this was wireless Morse code telegraphy(电报通讯), the principal communication technology of his day.
wireless.translationZh: 最初，这指的是无线莫尔斯电码电报通讯，这是他那个时代的主要通信技术。

wireless.sentenceEn: What made the link from then to now was the development of wireless communication.
wireless.translationZh: 而从那时到现在的关键纽带，便是无线通信的发展。

wireless.sentenceEn: Marconi was the first to develop a practical method for wireless telegraphy using radio waves.
wireless.translationZh: 马可尼是首位开发出利用无线电波实现无线电报通讯实用方法的人。

wireless.sentenceEn: He was the first person to imagine a practical application for the wireless spectrum, and to develop it successfully into a global communication system—in both terms of the word; that is, worldwide and all-inclusive.
wireless.translationZh: 他是首位设想无线频谱实际应用，并将其成功发展为全球通信系统的人——这里的“全球”有双重含义，即覆盖世界各地且包容万物。

wireless.sentenceEn: What connected the 19th century and our present time was the development of wireless communication.
wireless.translationZh: 连接19世纪与我们当今时代的是无线通信的发展。

wireless.sentenceEn: How Marconi Gave Us the Wireless World
wireless.translationZh: 马可尼如何为我们创造了无线世界

worst.sentenceEn: If bosses don't communicate effectively, employees assume the worst .
worst.translationZh: 如果老板沟通不畅，员工就会往最坏的方面想。
worst.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第6段，第1句

worst.sentenceEn: After a century of ignorance, London was hit by the Great Smog of December 1952—the worst air-pollution event in the history of the United Kingdom which caused the deaths of approximately 12,000 people.
worst.translationZh: 在经历了一个世纪的忽视之后，伦敦于1952年12月遭遇了"大烟雾"事件——这是英国历史上最严重的空气污染事件，造成约12,000人死亡。

worst.sentenceEn: Instrumental music will have at worst a slight effect.
worst.translationZh: 器乐音乐最坏情况下也只会产生轻微影响。
worst.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第2句

worst.sentenceEn: At its worst it becomes something even more concerning: "biophobia," the fear of living things and a complete aversion to nature.
worst.translationZh: 最糟糕的情况下，它会演变成更令人担忧的问题："生物恐惧症"——即对生物的恐惧和对自然的完全厌恶。

worst.sentenceEn: Her output may be undeniable, but sceptics have suggested that she is guilty of erasing the role of ghost writers(代笔人) at worst , gross exaggeration at best.
worst.translationZh: 她的作品产量或许不容否认，但持怀疑态度的人认为，往坏处说，她是在抹杀代笔人的功劳；往好处说，她也有严重夸大之嫌。
worst.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第3句

worst.sentenceEn: Professor Stephen Hawking has warned that the creation of powerful artificial intelligence (AI) will be "either the best, or the worst thing, ever to happen to humanity", and praised the creation of an academic institute dedicated to researching the future of intelligence as "crucial to the future of our civilisation and our species".
worst.translationZh: 斯蒂芬·霍金教授警告称，强大的人工智能(AI)的诞生将是“人类历史上可能发生的最好的事情，也可能是最糟糕的事情”，并赞扬了一家致力于研究智能未来的学术机构的成立，称其“对我们文明和物种的未来至关重要”。
worst.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第1句

warning.sentenceEn: Red lights are a clear and consistent warning to stop.
warning.translationZh: 红灯是清晰且一致的停车信号。

warning.sentenceEn: Their heart rate is elevated, they occasionally glance around nervously, and they sometimes jump collectively in their seats, and emit high-pitched warning calls.
warning.translationZh: 他们的心率加快，偶尔紧张地环顾四周，有时会集体从座位上跳起，并发出尖锐的警告声。
warning.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第2句

warning.sentenceEn: The sudden decline in foot traffic in recent years, even though it hasn't been accompanied by a massive decline in physical sales, is a critical warning .
warning.translationZh: 近年来实体店客流量突然下降，尽管这并未伴随着实体销售额的大幅下滑，但已是一个严重的警告信号。

warning.sentenceEn: Journalist Sarah Scoles reports that NASA currently tracks about 24,000 objects in space, and in 2016 the Air Force had to issue 3,995,874 warnings to satellite owners alerting them to a potential nearby threat from another satellite or bit of debris.
warning.translationZh: 记者萨拉·斯科尔斯报道，美国国家航空航天局（NASA）目前正在追踪太空中约24,000个物体，而2016年美国空军不得不向卫星所有者发出3,995,874次警告，提醒他们注意来自其他卫星或太空碎片的潜在近距离威胁。
warning.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第3句

warning.sentenceEn: When the warning yellow light was introduced, driving became safer and traffic accidents reduced.
warning.translationZh: 随着黄色警示灯的引入，驾驶变得更加安全，交通事故也随之减少。

warning.sentenceEn: Their behaviors do not constitute a warning signal.
warning.translationZh: 他们的行为通常不被视为危险信号

wave.sentenceEn: According to researchers, listening to Mozart can increase brain wave activity and improve cognitive function.
wave.translationZh: 研究人员称，聆听莫扎特的音乐可以增强脑电波活动并改善认知功能。
wave.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第2句

wave.sentenceEn: When these bent light waves reach the other side of the water droplet, they reflect back out of the droplet instead of completely passing through the water.
wave.translationZh: 当这些弯曲的光波到达水滴的另一侧时，它们会反射出水滴，而不是完全穿过水。
wave.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第7句

wave.sentenceEn: The light waves change direction as they pass through the water droplets, resulting in two processes: reflection and refraction(折射).
wave.translationZh: 光波穿过水滴时会改变方向，这产生了两个过程：反射和折射。
wave.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第2句

wave.sentenceEn: Some individuals refer to refracted light as "bent light waves ."
wave.translationZh: 有些人将折射光称为"弯曲光波"。
wave.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第5句

wave.sentenceEn: Marconi was the first to develop and perfect this system, using the recently-discovered "air waves " that make up the electromagnetic spectrum.
wave.translationZh: 马可尼率先开发并完善了这一系统，他利用了当时新发现的构成电磁波谱的“空气波”。

wave.sentenceEn: Marconi was the first to develop a practical method for wireless telegraphy using radio waves .
wave.translationZh: 马可尼是首位开发出利用无线电波实现无线电报通讯实用方法的人。

worsen.sentenceEn: The UK's digital divide has worsened over the past two years, leaving poorer families without broadband connections in their homes.
worsen.translationZh: 过去两年间，英国的数字鸿沟进一步扩大，导致贫困家庭家中无法接入宽带网络。
worsen.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第6段，第1句

worsen.sentenceEn: To some extent, they are right: climate change has already destroyed tens of thousands of livelihoods, and the situation will worsen in the near future for millions of mostly poorer people, who will join the ranks of those who have already been displaced by climate change and extreme weather events.
worsen.translationZh: 在某种程度上，他们的看法不无道理：气候变化已经摧毁了成千上万人的生计，而在不久的将来，数百万贫困人口的处境将进一步恶化，他们将加入那些已因气候变化和极端天气事件而流离失所者的行列。

worsen.sentenceEn: Mass extinctions can be caused by a relatively rapid change in the environment and can be worsened by the close interrelationship of many species.
worsen.translationZh: 大规模灭绝可能由环境相对快速的变化引起，并且可能因许多物种之间密切的相互关系而加剧。
worsen.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第5段，第5句

weekly.sentenceEn: The next account was in 1906, again in the Athens Weekly Banner, again very clearly copying the original account, only slightly reworded, the 19th century equivalent of re-posts when the audience has forgotten about the original.
weekly.translationZh: 下一次记载出现在1906年，同样刊登于《雅典每周旗帜报》，同样是对原始记载的明显抄袭，仅做了些许文字修改，这相当于19世纪版的“重新发布”——当读者已经忘记原始内容时的再次分享。

weekly.sentenceEn: It is speculated to have been invented by the imagination of the said anonymous author at the Athens Weekly Banner in the aforementioned 1890 front page article titled "Deeded to Itself", which by the way contained several elements that are much more easily proved to be false.
weekly.translationZh: 据推测，这是那位匿名作者在《雅典每周旗帜报》1890年那篇标题为《赠予自身》的头版文章中凭空捏造的，顺便说一句，该文章包含若干内容现已被轻易证实为虚假。

weekly.sentenceEn: As to why he loved it so, the earliest documented account of this story is an anonymously written front page article in the Athens Weekly Banner published on August 12, 1890.
weekly.translationZh: 至于他为何如此喜爱它，这个故事最早的文字记载是1890年8月12日《雅典每周旗帜报》上一篇匿名撰写的头版文章。

weekly.sentenceEn: Whatever the case, the next known instance of the Tree That Owns Itself being mentioned wasn't until 1901 in the Centennial Edition of that same paper, the Athens Weekly Banner.
weekly.translationZh: 无论如何，有关“自拥其树”的下一次记载要等到1901年，在同一家报纸《雅典每周旗帜报》的百年纪念版中才再次提及。

weekly.sentenceEn: TD doctors make weekly visits to the remote islands to provide services at a temporary medical center.
weekly.translationZh: Teledaktar（TD）的医生每周前往偏远岛屿，在临时医疗中心提供服务。

weekly.sentenceEn: She can spread her academic ideas on a weekly TV show.
weekly.translationZh: 她可以在每周的电视节目中传播自己的学术观点。

willingness.sentenceEn: The solution to great team performance stems from a willingness to recruit others who could direct their passion towards the third phase of entrepreneurialism: developing the business.
willingness.translationZh: 打造卓越团队绩效的关键在于愿意招募那些能够将热情投入到创业第三阶段的人才：即企业发展阶段。
willingness.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第7段，第1句

willingness.sentenceEn: The willingness to take risks may inspire others to be more courageous.
willingness.translationZh: 创始人敢于冒险的精神可能会激励团队其他成员更加勇敢。
willingness.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第2句

willingness.sentenceEn: It increased employees' perception of the likelihood of success in the attainment of job goals, and therefore fostered a willingness to dedicate their effort and ability to their work.
willingness.translationZh: 这增强了员工对成功实现工作目标可能性的认知，从而培养了他们为工作付出努力和能力的意愿。
willingness.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第5段，第3句

willingness.sentenceEn: These behaviors clearly indicate a curiosity about what goes on in the mind of others, and probably a set of early intuitions coupled with a willingness to learn more.
willingness.translationZh: 这些行为清楚地表明幼儿对他人的想法怀有好奇心，并且很可能具备一系列早期直觉，同时渴望学习更多相关知识。

willingness.sentenceEn: Killy learned an important secret shared by many creative people: innovations don't require genius, just a willingness to question the way things have always been done.
willingness.translationZh: 基利领悟到了许多有创造力的人所共有的一个重要秘诀：创新并不需要天才，只需要有勇气去质疑那些一直以来被人们沿用的做事方式。
willingness.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第1句

willingness.sentenceEn: It inspires willingness to make sacrifices.
willingness.translationZh: 它激发了人们愿意做出牺牲的精神。

worse.sentenceEn: The more it was present, the worse they considered both the quality of the interaction and the quality of the relationship.
worse.translationZh: 这种情况出现的频率越高，他们对互动质量和关系质量的评价就越低。
worse.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第2句

worse.sentenceEn: The efforts of millions of drivers to get ahead do not miraculously produce a situation in which everyone does better than before, but one in which almost everyone does rather worse .
worse.translationZh: 数百万司机为争先而付出的努力，并未奇迹般地创造出人人都比以前更好的局面，反而导致了几乎所有人都变得更糟的结果。
worse.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第5句

worse.sentenceEn: No one knows whether the destruction of chimp culture is getting worse .
worse.translationZh: 没有人知道大猩猩文化的破坏是否正在加剧。
worse.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第7段，第1句

worse.sentenceEn: But students who surfed the web during class did worse on their exams regardless of their ACT scores, suggesting that even the academically smartest students are harmed when they're distracted in class.
worse.translationZh: 但无论ACT分数如何，在课堂上上网的学生考试成绩都较差，这表明即使是学业最优秀的学生，在课堂上分心时也会受到影响。
worse.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第4句

worse.sentenceEn: Even worse , after refreshing our email or reading the same studies over and over, we are too exhausted when we land to soldier on with(继续处理) the emails that have inevitably still piled up.
worse.translationZh: 更糟糕的是，在反复刷新邮箱或一遍遍阅读相同的研究报告后，我们落地时已疲惫不堪，根本无法继续处理那些不可避免地依旧堆积如山的邮件。

worse.sentenceEn: The reality is taking one's phone out at the wrong time is worse than belching because, unlike other minor offenses, checking tech is contagious.
worse.translationZh: 事实上，在不当场合拿出手机比当众打嗝更糟糕，因为与其他轻微失礼行为不同，查看电子设备具有传染性。

wander.sentenceEn: So we have wandered into a world in which machines make us do tricks to prove that we are humans!
wander.translationZh: 于是，我们竟然闯入了一个机器逼迫我们通过耍把戏来证明自己是人类的世界！
wander.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第4句

wander.sentenceEn: During the summer, when I was a visiting poet at a residency out of state, an angry, confused woman wandered into my class and said: "I have three guns and I want to use them."
wander.translationZh: 那年夏天，我作为客座诗人在州外的一个艺术家驻留项目任教时，一名愤怒而神情恍惚的女子闯入我的课堂，说道：“我有三把枪，我想用它们。”
wander.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第1句

wander.sentenceEn: Along the route, armed guards wandered the large sheets of floating ice to minimize the risk of polar bear attacks.
wander.translationZh: 沿途，武装警卫在巨大的浮冰上巡逻，以最大限度降低北极熊袭击的风险。

wander.sentenceEn: Most successful people are unorthodox persons whose minds wander outside traditional ways of thinking.
wander.translationZh: 大多数成功人士都是与众不同的人，他们的思维跳出传统的思考方式。
wander.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第1句

wander.sentenceEn: Allowing your mind to wander freely is conducive to sharpening your focus in the long run.
wander.translationZh: 从长远来看，让思绪自由驰骋有助于提高专注力。

wander.sentenceEn: It wanders for almost half of their waking time.
wander.translationZh: 人们在近一半的清醒时间里都在做白日梦。

willpower.sentenceEn: The research on whether we have finite or infinite willpower is inconclusive, but experts do generally agree that you can't change and sustain a habit if you rely on your willpower alone.
willpower.translationZh: 关于我们的意志力是有限还是无限的研究尚无定论，但专家们普遍认为，如果你仅依靠意志力，就无法改变并维持一个习惯。

willpower.sentenceEn: The first one to avoid is relying on willpower .
willpower.translationZh: 首先要避免的是依赖意志力。

willpower.sentenceEn: And if you want to increase that willpower , a new study suggests you just simply have to believe you have it.
willpower.translationZh: 而如果你想增强这种意志力，一项新研究表明，你只需要相信自己拥有它就行。
willpower.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第2句

willpower.sentenceEn: A good dose of willpower is often necessary to see any task through, whether it's sticking to a spending plan or finishing a great novel.
willpower.translationZh: 无论是坚持执行支出计划，还是完成一部鸿篇巨制的小说，要想圆满完成任何任务，往往都需要强大的意志力。
willpower.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第1句

willpower.sentenceEn: There is general consensus among experts that willpower alone cannot guarantee one's success in changing and maintaining a habit.
willpower.translationZh: 专家们普遍认为，仅凭意志力无法保证一个人成功改变并保持习惯。

willpower.sentenceEn: It is most important to have confidence in one's willpower .
willpower.translationZh: 最重要的是对自己的意志力有信心。

worthy.sentenceEn: For snobs, it is the already acclaimed and already successful who are the only ones worthy of respect.
worthy.translationZh: 对于势利小人而言，只有那些已经获得赞誉和成功的人才值得尊重。
worthy.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第7段，第3句

worthy.sentenceEn: It isn't ground-breaking to say workers feel fatigued after a meeting, but only in recent decades have scientists deemed the condition worthy of further investigation.
worthy.translationZh: 说员工开会后感到疲劳并非什么惊天动地的发现，但直到最近几十年，科学家们才认为这种情况值得进一步研究。

worthy.sentenceEn: For example, if people feel they are not worthy of kindness or suspect that some ulterior(别有用心的) motive lies behind it, the benefits of gratitude will not be realized.
worthy.translationZh: 例如，如果人们觉得自己不配得到善意，或者怀疑善意背后隐藏着别有用心的动机，感恩所带来的益处就无法实现。

worthy.sentenceEn: The researchers found that when people choose to cultivate and maintain supportive friendships with an individual, it means that the person is valued and worthy of their limited time.
worthy.translationZh: 研究人员发现，当人们选择与某人培养并维持互助的友谊关系时，这意味着此人受到重视，值得他们投入有限的时间。
worthy.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第4句

worthy.sentenceEn: The FAO was worthy of praise in that it admitted its mistake once it was pointed out.
worthy.translationZh: 粮农组织在错误被指出后能够承认错误，这一点值得称赞。

worthy.sentenceEn: They are worthy of a prize.

wipe.sentenceEn: M: Well, depending on the ensuing operative scenario, if I need to wipe the system directories clean in order to reconfigure default protocols, then my first intervention should be to intricately retrieve all inventories that I can.
wipe.translationZh: 男：嗯，这取决于接下来的操作场景。如果我需要清空系统目录以重新配置默认协议，那么我的首要措施应该是尽可能详细地检索所有清单。
wipe.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第13段，第1句

wipe.sentenceEn: It is the biggest loss of species since the dinosaurs were wiped out 66 million years ago.
wipe.translationZh: 这是自6600万年前恐龙灭绝以来最大规模的物种灭绝事件。
wipe.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第2句

wipe.sentenceEn: Since 1970, humanity has wiped out 60 percent of animal populations.
wipe.translationZh: 自1970年以来，人类已导致60%的动物种群消失。
wipe.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第5段，第2句

wipe.sentenceEn: Unthinkable as it may be, humanity, every last person, could someday be wiped from the face of the Earth.
wipe.translationZh: 尽管这可能令人难以置信，但人类——每一个人——终有一天可能会从地球表面被彻底消灭。
wipe.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第1句

wipe.sentenceEn: For many in those countries, wiping their shoes before going inside is regarded as sufficient.
wipe.translationZh: 在这些国家的许多人看来，进门之前擦擦鞋就足够了。
wipe.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第2句

wipe.sentenceEn: And, ironic as it sounds, since humans have wiped out many animal predators, some see hunting as a natural way to reduce the herds of prey animals that now reproduce beyond the environment's carrying capacity.
wipe.translationZh: 然而，听起来颇具讽刺意味的是，由于人类已经消灭了许多肉食动物，一些人将狩猎视为一种自然的方式，以减少如今繁殖数量已超出环境承载能力的猎物群。
wipe.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第4句

workday.sentenceEn: Take buying lunch on workdays for example.
workday.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第13句

workday.sentenceEn: Some can bounce back quickly, while others carry their fatigue until the end of the workday .
workday.translationZh: 有些人能迅速恢复精力，而另一些人则会带着疲惫直到工作日结束。

workday.sentenceEn: Over time as employees find themselves tied up in more and more unnecessary meetings—and thus dealing with increasing lag times from MRS—the waste of workday hours can feel insulting.
workday.translationZh: 随着时间推移，员工发现自己深陷越来越多不必要的会议之中——因此也不得不应对MRS带来的日益增长的延迟——工作日时间的这种浪费会让人感到非常荒谬。

workday.sentenceEn: And though experts agree that traditional meetings are essential for making certain decisions and developing strategy, some employees view them as one of the most unnecessary parts of the workday .
workday.translationZh: 尽管专家们一致认为传统会议对于做出某些决策和制定战略至关重要，但一些员工仍将其视为工作日中最不必要的环节之一。

workday.sentenceEn: Some employees consider meetings one of the most dispensable parts of the workday .
workday.translationZh: 有些员工认为会议是工作日中最可有可无的部分之一。

workday.sentenceEn: Blame your worthless workdays on meeting recovery syndrome
workday.translationZh: 把你毫无价值的工作日归咎于会议恢复期综合征

weakness.sentenceEn: Losing gives them a sense of weakness , inadequacy, and failure.
weakness.translationZh: 失败会让他们产生软弱、不足和失败感。
weakness.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第6句

weakness.sentenceEn: At more than 7 billion, human population dwarfs that of nearly all other mammals—despite our physical weaknesses .
weakness.translationZh: 尽管人类在体能上存在弱点，但全球人口已超过70亿，这一数字令几乎所有其他哺乳动物的种群数量都相形见绌。
weakness.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第4句

weakness.sentenceEn: These messages are part of your survival mechanism and should not be stifled simply because emotions are unhealthy and betray your weaknesses .
weakness.translationZh: 这些信号是你生存机制的一部分，不应仅仅因为情绪被视为不健康或暴露了你的弱点而被压抑。
weakness.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第3句

weakness.sentenceEn: Consequently, the old view of children's egocentric(自我中心的) nature and intellectual weaknesses has increasingly fallen out of favor and become replaced by a more generous position that sees a budding sense not only of the physical world but also of other minds, even in the "youngest young."
weakness.translationZh: 因此，认为儿童具有自我中心本性和智力缺陷的旧观点已日益失去支持，取而代之的是一种更包容的看法——该观点认为，即便是在'最小的幼儿'身上，也不仅萌发出对物质世界的感知，还形成了对他人心智的初步理解。

weakness.sentenceEn: What's one of the man's weaknesses ?
weakness.translationZh: 这位男士的一个缺点是什么？

weakness.sentenceEn: It masks the fatal weaknesses of government policy.
weakness.translationZh: 它掩盖了政府政策的致命弱点。

widen.sentenceEn: One clear piece of evidence is the widening gap between productivity growth and wage growth since roughly 1970.
widen.translationZh: 一个明显的证据是，自大约1970年以来，生产率增长与工资增长之间的差距不断扩大。
widen.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第12段，第3句

widen.sentenceEn: Doing a poor job communicating science to the public will only create confusion and widen the gap between science and society, a gap that scientists are trying to close.
widen.translationZh: 向公众传播科学时表现不佳，只会造成混乱并扩大科学与社会之间的鸿沟——这正是科学家们正努力弥合的鸿沟。
widen.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第6段，第5句

widen.sentenceEn: These forms of tourism widen economic and political gaps between haves and have-nots at local destinations.
widen.translationZh: 这类旅游形式加剧了旅游目的地本地富人与穷人之间的经济和政治差距。
widen.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第6段，第2句

widen.sentenceEn: Even if new jobs and wonderful products emerge, in the short term income gaps will widen , causing huge social dislocation and perhaps even changing politics.
widen.translationZh: 即便新的就业岗位和优质产品不断涌现，短期内收入差距仍会扩大，这将造成严重的社会动荡，甚至可能改变政治格局。
widen.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第2句

widen.sentenceEn: It can widen the gap between kids from different economic statuses.
widen.translationZh: 这可能会扩大不同经济状况儿童之间的差距。

wit.sentenceEn: Similarly, an occasional dash of sarcastic wit can spice up a chat and add an element of humor to it.
wit.translationZh: 同样，偶尔的一丝讽刺意味的机智言辞能为聊天增添趣味，注入幽默元素。
wit.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第7段，第4句

wit.sentenceEn: In essence, sarcasm is easy while true, harmless wit takes talent.
wit.translationZh: 本质上，讽刺很容易，但真正无害的机智则需要天赋。
wit.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第8段，第2句

wit.sentenceEn: So, tone down the sarcasm and work on clever wit instead, which is usually without any hostility and thus more appreciated by those you're communicating with.
wit.translationZh: 所以，收敛一下你的讽刺，多运用些巧妙的智慧吧。后者通常不带任何敌意，因此更容易被与你交流的人所欣赏。
wit.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第8段，第1句

wit.sentenceEn: Thus, the main difference between wit and sarcasm is that, as already stated, sarcasm is often hostility disguised as humor.
wit.translationZh: 因此，正如前面所述，机智与讽刺的主要区别在于：讽刺往往是伪装成幽默的敌意。
wit.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第9段，第1句

wit.sentenceEn: What is the chief difference between a speaker's wit and sarcasm?
wit.translationZh: 说话者的机智与讽刺之间的主要区别是什么？

wit.sentenceEn: Musicians are often at their wits' end in their creative effort.
wit.translationZh: 音乐家在创作过程中常常会陷入文思枯竭的境地。

workout.sentenceEn: After the workout , the app's artificial intelligence software system gives feedback from Ms. Weiner and its other 53 million users around the world to adjust future training sessions.
workout.translationZh: 锻炼结束后，该应用的人工智能软件系统会结合Weiner女士及全球其他5300万用户的反馈，来调整未来的训练课程。
workout.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第10句

workout.sentenceEn: The app's mathematical approach can arrange a more meticulous workout schedule.
workout.translationZh: 这款应用的数学算法能够制定出更细致的锻炼计划。
workout.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第14句

workout.sentenceEn: Now Ms. Weiner finds the workouts exciting.
workout.translationZh: 现在韦纳女士觉得这些锻炼很有趣。
workout.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第11句

workout.sentenceEn: However, her workouts lacked intensity without a proper training programme to follow.
workout.translationZh: 然而，如果没有合适的训练计划可循，她的锻炼就缺乏强度。
workout.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第3句

workout.sentenceEn: Why does the passage say Jenny Weiner now finds the workouts exciting?
workout.translationZh: 为什么文章说珍妮·韦纳现在觉得锻炼很有趣？

workout.sentenceEn: They cannot match humans in arranging meticulous workout schedules.
workout.translationZh: 它们无法像人类一样制定细致的锻炼计划。

wrap.sentenceEn: "But then your whole identity gets wrapped into a goal."
wrap.translationZh: 但随后你的整个身份都与某个目标紧紧捆绑在了一起。

wrap.sentenceEn: We just wrapped up a project with a difficult client last week.
wrap.translationZh: 我们上周刚和一个难缠的客户完成了一个项目。
wrap.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第4句

wrap.sentenceEn: In Hong Kong, I've seen girls wrapping their whole body or both legs up with a special type of slimming tape which is supposed to help make them thinner.
wrap.translationZh: 在香港，我见过女孩们用一种特殊的瘦身胶带把整个身体或双腿都缠起来，据说这样能帮助她们变瘦。
wrap.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第2句

wrap.sentenceEn: Independence came in tying, wrapping , storing, harmonizing, and rationalizing that wardrobe.
wrap.translationZh: 这种独立体现在服装的系束、包裹、收纳、搭配协调以及合理化设计上。
wrap.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第2句

wrap.sentenceEn: Nearly all the cultural objects we consume arrive wrapped in inherited opinion; our preferences are always, to some extent, someone else's.
wrap.translationZh: 我们接触的几乎所有文化作品都裹挟着前人的评价；在某种程度上，我们的偏好总是他人的偏好。

wrap.sentenceEn: What does the speaker think of girls wrapping their legs up with slimming tape?
wrap.translationZh: 说话者如何看待女孩们用瘦身胶带缠绕双腿的行为？
